# protocomm-posix Vendored Components

When running CMake, the following components will be downloaded (skipped if already present):
- `esp-idf-protocomm`: ESP-IDF's [`protocomm` component (v6.0.2)](https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/tree/v6.0.2/components/protocomm) — pinned by `ESP_PROTOCOMM_VENDOR_IDF_TAG` in [`../component_dir_setup.cmake`](../component_dir_setup.cmake)
